description: This PHP class 'NavigationContentLinks' builds and manages menu links for the Content menu in a Drupal module, including creating links for content types, media, and user creation, with route validation.

classes.name: NavigationContentLinks
classes.description: A final class implementing ContainerInjectionInterface that manages the addition of menu links for content, media, and user creation in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting RouteProviderInterface and EntityTypeManagerInterface dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the class using a container, retrieving route provider and entity type manager services.

methods.name: addMenuLinks
methods.description: Adds top-level menu links and create entity links to the provided links array, including a user creation link.

methods.name: addCreateEntityLinks
methods.description: Adds links for each entity type, sorted alphabetically, with optional bundle filtering, preserving order.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Validates route existence and adds a link to the links array, handling missing routes gracefully.
